{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id count: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {duplicates['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")"}
